right now it's in the hundreds of agents. the real number is tens of thousands, and that takes time, but the model is the same at every step. more agents on record means more accounts, more usage and more revenue.

they keep shipping regardless of the market. they're starting to have accounts cross-chain too. in a better market, and once agent usage hits its growth curve, i think 20-50m+ is a fair range, and higher from there as the agent count scales.
